title: Petrichor — the smell of rain on dry ground
Apricity — the warmth of the sun, felt in winter
Susurrus — a soft whispering or rustling sound
Crepuscular — of twilight, or active in it
Liminal — on a threshold, between one state and the next
Defenestrate — to throw out of a window
Borborygmus — the rumble of a hungry stomach
Psithurism — the sound of wind moving through trees
Saudade — longing for something absent that may never return
Ultracrepidarian — a person who opines well beyond their knowledge
Mellifluous — sweetly flowing, said of a voice
Halcyon — calm and golden, said of remembered days
Lacuna — a gap, especially in a text or an argument
Quotidian — everyday; belonging to the ordinary run of things
Velleity — a wish too faint to act on
Nepenthe — a thing that makes you forget sorrow
Frisson — a sudden shiver of excitement
Zugzwang — the spot where every possible move makes it worse
Sprezzatura — studied carelessness; art hiding its effort
Tsundoku — buying books and letting them pile up unread
